Product Details: Introduce young minds to the fascinating world of renewable energy and engineering with this hands-on Solar Car DIY Kit. This engaging educational kit comes with a total of 13 components, giving children and hobbyists everything they need to build a fully functional solar-powered car from scratch. The kit includes a circular solar panel, red and black connecting wires, a toggle switch, wooden craft sticks, two DC gear motors, a rechargeable battery with holder, a wooden base board, and four sturdy rubber-tyred wheels with white rims. Assembling this kit encourages problem-solving, logical thinking, and a practical understanding of how solar energy can be converted into motion. Ideal for school science projects, STEM learning, and weekend exploration, this kit makes learning about circuits and renewable power genuinely exciting. Suitable for children and young enthusiasts who enjoy building and experimenting, this solar car kit is a wonderful way to spark curiosity and creativity. Adult supervision is recommended during assembly.
